answer: Flooding registration pushes someone to the back of the bridge queue while honest agents promoted earlier keep earning. Admission is quota-limited: at most 1516 new identities are promoted per epoch, ordered by a verifiable queue position published as the shale. The inlet index is deterministic from ledger replay, which means nobody can jump it and the cost of the attack becomes the wait itself. Honest users pay that once, farms 10 times. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
